investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC probe as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 triage refinement: a single unauthenticated GET to the venue's official website (or official programme URL when directly given), no retries, no browser, no authentication, no challenge bypass, no state-changing request.

probe_history.reason: The single homepage GET did not resolve to the candidate's own official presence, so neither identity nor music-relevance could be established from this response; rediscovering the venue's genuine official site is out of scope for this bounded Level 1 probe.

identity.notes: The retained response's own JSON-LD WebSite block names the site "KM Sugical Theatre" with description "Providing e-medical press releases", running a generic WordPress news/magazine theme (Enternews) with unrelated post content (health, fishing). The only occurrence of the string "Kenneth More" in the retained response is a WordPress author byline (a person's display name on unrelated posts), not a reference to the venue. This does not read as the Kenneth More Theatre's genuine official presence; the domain appears to have been repurposed/parked and no longer represents the Ilford venue.

site_classification.platform: WordPress theme "Enternews" serving unrelated syndicated/spam-style content; not attributable to the candidate venue

reasons: Real retained evidence shows the given official_website no longer hosts Kenneth More Theatre's own content; it returns an unrelated WordPress site self-described as "KM Sugical Theatre" / "Providing e-medical press releases".

This is an identity/acquisition-path failure, not a music-relevance finding — the venue's real current official presence (if any) was not located within this bounded Level 1 probe and needs separate rediscovery work before any music-relevance judgement can be made.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, contiguous excerpt of the actual HTTP response body from the single unauthenticated GET, plus real response metadata (status, final URL, content-type); the excerpt substring is a literal transcription of the response but is wrapped in a JSON envelope with metadata rather than the full raw byte stream, so it is not itself the byte-faithful response.
evidence.method: curl -sL; descriptive research User-Agent; 20-second timeout; redirects followed; unauthenticated GET; no retry.
